guide:
Covers are looked up at Rawg, then at Twitch, then at Steam. A Rawg code is optional, but it widens the results.

1. Create a free account on [rawg.io/apidocs](https://rawg.io/apidocs) and copy your access code.
2. Open the “Settings” tab of this page and paste it in “Free Rawg access code”.
3. Come back here and click “Test the code”.
key_adopted: Your site's access code was picked up automatically: there is nothing for you to redo. To replace it, paste another one in the “Settings” tab.
forgot_key: Done: the picked-up code is forgotten.
test_refused: Rawg refuses this access code. Check it on rawg.io/apidocs.
test_unreachable: RAWG cannot be reached from this server. Try again in a moment.
test_no_key: No code yet: paste it in the “Settings” tab first.
test_invalid: This code does not have the right format (letters, digits, dashes, at least 8 characters). Copy it again from rawg.io/apidocs.
todo_intro: When the site is not sure which game matches a title, it lists it here. If it is not the right game, click “Fix”. If it is the right one, click “This one is right”.
todo_empty: Nothing to check for now: all covers look right.
todo_more: … and {count} older titles. Fix the ones above: the list updates.
which_intro: Pick the game that matches this title. The site will keep your choice.
search_help: If the right game is not in the list, type its real name here (example: Astro's Playroom).
none_help: The site will show no picture for this title.
status_none: No source has a game with a picture for this name. Try another name above, or choose “No cover”.
status_no_key: No source is available. Turn on Steam in the “Settings” tab, or enter a Rawg code.
status_refused: Rawg refuses the access code. Check it in the “Settings” tab.
status_unreachable: The sources are not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
status_rate: You are going too fast. Wait a minute, then reload the page.
saved_game: Noted: this cover is kept for this title.
saved_none: Noted: this title will no longer have a cover.
saved_confirm: Noted: the site's choice is kept for this title.
saved_forgot: Done: the site will choose by itself again.
err_title: This title is not valid. It needs 1 to 120 characters, with at least one letter or digit.
err_full: There are already 1000 corrections. Forget a few in the “Kept covers” tab, then try again.
err_candidate: This game is no longer in the proposed list. Reload the page and pick another one.
err_image: This picture is not accepted. Pick a game from the list.
err_rate: You are going too fast. Wait a minute, then try again.
err_nothing: There is no cover to keep for this title. Pick a game from the list.
err_no_key: No source is available. Turn on Steam in the “Settings” tab, or enter a Rawg code.
err_refused: Rawg refuses the access code. Check it in the “Settings” tab.
err_unreachable: The sources are not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
err_search: This name is too long: 100 characters at most. Try for example Hollow Knight.
err_forget: This cover is no longer kept, or you are going too fast. Reload the page.
saved_intro: The covers the site keeps for your games, including the ones it found by itself, with their source. You can view, change or forget them.
find_help: The title, as your pages write it.
err_find: Write the name of a game, for example Hollow Knight.
saved_empty: Nothing kept yet. Look for a cover above, or correct a cover to check.
forget_msg: The cover of “{title}” will be forgotten; the site will look again on its own.
forget_gone: This cover is no longer kept. Go back to the list.
outage: No source is answering right now. The covers already kept stay displayed.
outage_saved: The covers in this table stay displayed on the site in the meantime.
none_available: No source is available. Turn on Steam in the “Settings” tab, or enter a Rawg code.
